script: [serious] Five Navy bombers flew out over the Atlantic, and never came back. December 5th, 1945. Flight 19, five Avengers, fourteen men, led by Lieutenant Charles Taylor. His compasses failed. He believed he was over the Florida Keys. He wasn't. The planes flew on, out over open sea, until the radio went quiet. A rescue plane with thirteen men went to find them. It vanished too. No bodies. No wreckage. The Navy first blamed Taylor. Then it changed the verdict to cause unknown. Navigation error, or the Bermuda Triangle? You decide. This is Dossier Decoded. Case file number twenty. A new file every day.
